title: Israel’s anti-Netanyahu bloc needs Europe’s help to stabilise Middle East
lede: The recent elections in Israel and the US create a narrow geopolitical opening for de-escalation in the Middle East, which Europe should seize upon instead of playing wait and see.

title: The clock is ticking: Europe is running out of time to save the International Criminal Court
lede: The US midterms have opened a political window for Europe. With a key US licence expiring in April 2027, Brussels must turn its rhetorical support for the ICC into concrete action before this opportunity closes.
